question:
An office held a Secret Santa gift exchange where each of its twelve employees was assigned one other employee in the group to present with a gift. Each employee filled out a profile including three likes or hobbies. On the day of the gift exchange, only eleven gifts were given, each one specific to one of the recipient's interests. Based on the information in the document, who did not give a gift?

```python
from docx import Document

path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/cffe0e32-c9a6-4c52-9877-78ceb4aaa9fb.docx"
doc = Document(path)

# Extract employees
employees = []
for i in range(2, 14):
    name = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if name:
        employees.append(name)

# Extract profiles
profiles = {}
for i in range(21, 33):
    line = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if ":" in line:
        name, interests = line.split(":", 1)
        profiles[name.strip()] = [x.strip() for x in interests.split(",")]

# Gifts list
gifts = [doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip() for i in range(36, 47) if doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()]

# Map gift to interest keyword
gift_interest_map = {
    "Galileo Galilei biography": "Astronomy",
    "Fishing reel": "Fishing",
    "Raku programming guide": "Perl",
    "Chisel set": "Woodworking",
    "Custom dice": "Tabletop RPGs",
    "“War and Peace” American film copy": "Old Movies",
    "Yarn": "Knitting",
    "“One Piece” graphic novel": "Manga",
    "“War and Peace” novel": "Historical Fiction Novels",
    "Starbucks gift card": "Coffee",
    "Foam exercise mat": "Yoga"
}

# Determine recipients by interest match
recipients = set()
for gift, interest in gift_interest_map.items():
    for name, ints in profiles.items():
        if interest in ints:
            recipients.add(name)
            break

missing = [e for e in employees if e not in recipients]

# Assumed rotation mapping: giver -> next person, last -> first
rotation_map = {}
for idx, giver in enumerate(employees):
    recipient = employees[(idx + 1) % len(employees)]
    rotation_map[giver] = recipient

# Non-giver is who was supposed to give to the missing recipient
non_giver = None
if missing:
    missing_recipient = missing[0]
    for giver, rec in rotation_map.items():
        if rec == missing_recipient:
            non_giver = giver
            break

print("Recipients matched from gifts:", sorted(list(recipients)))
print("Missing recipient:", missing)
print("Non-giver per assumed rotation:", non_giver)
```
